jobs.desc: Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building. Job Role: SEO / AEO Manager Job Type: Contract - USA Job Description About This Role Bounteous is leading the charge in dynamic digital experiences and is looking for forward-thinking search experts to help drive measurable impact for some of the world's most recognizable and ambitious brands. In today's AI-driven, zero-click search landscape, our approach helps brands envision, harness, and enable their digital presence across traditional search engines, AI-powered discovery platforms, and emerging search experiences. We are seeking a SEO / AEO Manager to lead holistic search strategy across our client portfolio, spanning traditional SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), and AI search visibility across platforms including Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot. This individual will drive performance across traditional SEO, AEO, and AI-powered search experiences. The ideal candidate understands how search has evolved beyond rankings- into entities, AI Overviews, generative search, and full-SERP ownership, and can translate that evolution into business growth. The ideal candidate has already built or scaled an AI-search-visibility practice, not just a traditional SEO program with AI terminology added on top. This contractor will work cross-functionally with internal teams and client stakeholders to develop and execute advanced search strategies that drive visibility, authority, and measurable ROI, defined jointly with each client at engagement kickoff (see Success Metrics below). Role Responsibilities As the SEO AEO Manager, you will lead strategic search initiatives across enterprise client accounts, driving business growth and client success as a key member of our search practice. You will own strategy development, execution oversight, and performance measurement across traditional SEO and AI-driven search ecosystems. Develop strategies to capture and optimize for AI Overviews, Featured Snippets, People Also Ask, zero-click search experiences, and conversational queries. Drive entity-based optimization strategies to strengthen brand authority and knowledge graph presence. Partner with content and digital teams to align SEO strategy with E-E-A-T best practices. AI Emerging Search Optimization Optimize content and technical implementations for AI-driven search environments, including generative search engines and LLM discovery platforms, specifically ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, Gemini, and Copilot. Develop structured data and schema strategies to enhance visibility in rich results, AI summaries, and enhanced SERP features. Monitor evolving search engine algorithms and AI search trends, proactively adjusting strategy to maintain competitive advantage. Establish processes for measuring AI search visibility and zero-click performance impact. Technical Content SEO Execution Perform and present comprehensive technical, content, competitive, local, and app SEO audits. Develop SEO functional specifications for technical enhancements, partnering with developers to implement, QA, and UAT updates. Conduct advanced keyword, topic cluster, and entity research to inform scalable content strategies. Identify opportunities for content optimization, consolidation, pruning, and authority building. Cross-Functional Client Collaboration Collaborate closely with paid search, analytics, UX, product, and development teams to drive integrated search performance. Present insights and recommendations to internal and client stakeholders, translating complex SEO and AI-search concepts into business-focused outcomes. Align search strategies with broader omnichannel marketing and digital transformation initiatives. Data, Measurement Automation Take a data-driven approach to measuring SEO and AEO ROI against the metrics defined in Success Metrics below. Develop reporting frameworks that account for traditional traffic, zero-click engagement, SERP feature ownership, and AI search visibility. Leverage automation tools, APIs, AI workflows, and scripting (e.g., Python, Google Apps Script, or SQL) to improve efficiency and scalability. ~~advanced Excel or scripting capabilities~~ Use reporting and visualization platforms (e.g., Looker Studio, Tableau) to communicate performance insights and strategic opportunities. Project Management Delivery Manage project timelines and deliverables within project management systems (e.g., JIRA), ensuring deadlines and quality standards are met. Operate effectively in a contractor capacity, managing priorities across multiple accounts while maintaining strategic clarity and execution rigor. AI Overviews and generative search experiences Structured data and schema implementation Entity-based optimization and knowledge graph strategy E-E-A-T frameworks and authority-building strategies Hands-on experience with leading SEO platforms: SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Lumar (DeepCrawl), Yext, Lighthouse, and Google Business Profile. Hands-on experience with at least one dedicated AI-visibility/citation-tracking platform (e.g., Profound, Peec AI, Scrunch AI, AthenaHQ, or the AI-visibility modules within Semrush/Ahrefs). Experience managing project timelines and deliverables within a PM system (e.g., JIRA). Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and business recommendations. Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to senior stakeholders and client leadership teams. Â Preferred Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Familiarity with AI-powered workflows, automation tools, APIs, and scripting (Python, SQL, or Google Apps Script) for reporting automation. Prior experience managing search strategy across multiple concurrent client accounts in an agency or consultancy setting. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Platform
jobs.desc: div class= content-intro p strong Our Global Structure /strong /p p br Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team. /p /div h2 strong Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Platform /strong /h2 p nbsp; /p h2 strong About the Team /strong /h2 p Deliveroo s GenAI Platform team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared infrastructure that helps DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo teams safely bring GenAI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalisation to production. Our mission is to increase the velocity of business impact from GenAI. A central pillar of that work is running frontier open-weight LLMs and VLMs (such as GLM, Qwen, Kimi, and DeepSeek) ourselves — real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning on autoscaling GPUs — delivering large cost and latency wins (for example, a billion embeddings produced roughly 20× cheaper and visual models served roughly 72% cheaper).
